stories.headline: US private payrolls jumped 122,000 in May, ADP's strongest reading since January 2025

key_facts.fact: ADP reported private employers added 122,000 jobs in May, above the Dow Jones consensus of 110,000 and the largest gain since January 2025

Eight of 10 sectors gained, with education and health services adding 57,000, trade/transportation/utilities 36,000, professional and business services 11,000, construction and leisure/hospitality each 8,000
Information lost 9,000 jobs and natural resources/mining shed 3,000
Companies with fewer than 50 employees led with 67,000 hires, large employers (500+) added 40,000, and medium-sized firms contributed 17,000
Year-over-year pay growth for job-stayers held steady at 4.4%; pay growth for job-changers slowed slightly to 6.5% from 6.6% in April
April private payrolls were revised down from 109,000 to 105,000

stories.headline: Altman, Amodei, Hassabis, Suleyman urge Congress to mandate synthetic DNA screening

key_facts.fact: Sam Altman (OpenAI), Dario Amodei (Anthropic), Demis Hassabis (Google DeepMind), Mustafa Suleyman (Microsoft AI), and Alexandr Wang (Meta) signed an open letter calling for mandatory federal screening of orders for synthetic nucleic acids and the equipment to make them.
Signatories also include Nobel laureates David Baker and Martin Hellman; the letter says AI systems now outperform PhD-level virologists on lab procedure questions.
The letter asks providers of synthesized DNA to check requests against sequences of concern, verify customer legitimacy, and keep records so threats can be traced back to the source.
The letter urges Congress to act this session and asks states to base requirements on existing federal and industry guidelines to avoid a patchwork of conflicting laws.

stories.headline: Amazon unveils next-gen Proteus warehouse robot that takes plain-language commands

key_facts.fact: Amazon unveiled a next-generation Proteus warehouse robot at its 'Delivering the Future' event in Dartford, near London, on June 4.
The new Proteus can operate anywhere across fulfillment sites and accepts text-based conversational prompts, without technical commands or programming interfaces.
Proteus can move heavy carts weighing up to about 400 kg (882 lbs) and is currently in lab pilots; European deployment is planned for the first half of 2027.
Amazon also announced more than €10 billion (~$11.6B) of investment in European fulfillment over the coming years, plus 25,000 new jobs.
The current Proteus is already operating at 25 Amazon facilities across the United States, primarily moving heavy carts in dock areas.
Amazon also expanded STARK, a collaborative tote-handling robot, planning rollout to 15 European sites by 2027, plus Vulcan, a robot with a 'sense of touch,' now in Hamburg.

stories.headline: Broadcom Q2 sales grow 48% to $22.2B but AI guidance underwhelms; shares fall 12%+

key_facts.fact: Broadcom reported Q2 fiscal 2026 revenue of $22.19 billion, up 48% YoY, missing analyst estimates of $22.27 billion.
Q2 AI semiconductor revenue reached $10.8 billion, up 143% YoY, driven by demand for custom AI accelerators and AI networking.
Broadcom forecast Q3 AI chip revenue of $16 billion, slightly below analyst estimates of $16.36 billion, and stuck to a long-range forecast of $100 billion in AI chip sales.
CEO Hock Tan said Broadcom now expects to ship more than 10 gigawatts of AI chip compute in 2027 and 'a lot more' in 2028.
AVGO shares fell more than 12% in pre-market trading on June 4, dragging Micron and SanDisk down more than 6%.
Broadcom guided Q3 revenue of approximately $29.4 billion, an 84% YoY increase, above analyst estimate of $28.54 billion.

stories.headline: US tech sector announced 38,242 job cuts in May, the most in nearly two years

key_facts.fact: US tech companies announced 38,242 job cuts in May, the most since August 2024, according to Challenger, Gray & Christmas
Year-to-date tech-sector job cuts have reached 123,653, up 65% from the same period in 2025
Overall US employers announced 97,006 job cuts in May, up from 83,387 in April

stories.headline: Bezos leads $500M raise for Flourish, hunting the brain's 'core algorithm' for efficient AI

key_facts.fact: Flourish closed a $500M funding round at a $2.5B valuation, with Jeff Bezos leading the investment, according to WIRED.
Flourish was founded by Thomas Reardon, who built Internet Explorer at Microsoft and previously sold neural-interface startup CTRL-labs to Meta for up to $1 billion in 2019.

The startup studies connectomics (neural connections in the brain) to design AI architectures that are radically more energy-efficient, targeting the architectural layer above silicon rather than building new chips.
The human brain runs on about 20 watts, while leading AI systems require megawatts; closing this efficiency gap is Flourish's stated goal.

stories.headline: Foxconn and Intel announce strategic partnership on next-gen AI infrastructure

key_facts.fact: Foxconn and Intel announced on June 4 a strategic collaboration to jointly develop AI infrastructure spanning silicon, racks, systems, and applications.

The partnership will build rack-scale AI infrastructure systems combining Intel Xeon processors with AI accelerators, plus high-speed interconnects, liquid cooling, and scalable data center architectures.
Beyond infrastructure, the companies will also collaborate on custom ASIC design and system integration services.
At Computex on June 2, Intel had already pre-announced racks combining Xeon processors with SambaNova SN-50 RDUs, with Foxconn providing systems integration.
A single liquid-cooled Xeon 6+ rack can deliver 36,864 cores in 32U at roughly 100 kW of rack power.

stories.headline: Robotics startup Generalist AI raises $400M at $2B valuation led by Radical Ventures

key_facts.fact: Generalist AI, a robotics startup, raised $400 million in a new funding round at a $2 billion valuation, announced Thursday June 4.
Radical Ventures led the round with participation from 8VC, Union Square Ventures, Hanabi Capital, plus existing investors Nvidia and Bezos Expeditions.
Generalist AI was founded by Pete Florence, Andy Zeng, and Andy Barry, and is known for training large-parameter models from scratch.
Generalist released its GEN-1 model for short physical tasks in April and recently joined Nvidia's Cosmos Coalition for open world models.

stories.headline: Google releases Gemma 4 12B, an encoder-free multimodal open model that runs on 16GB laptops

key_facts.fact: Google released Gemma 4 12B, an 11.95B-parameter dense encoder-free multimodal model under Apache 2.0 on June 3, 2026.
The 12B model uses no separate vision or audio encoders, projecting raw image patches and audio waveforms directly into the LLM embedding space via lightweight linear layers.
Gemma 4 12B has a 256K-token context window and is small enough to run locally with just 16GB of VRAM or unified memory.
Google's broader Gemma 4 family scores 89.2% on AIME 2026 (31B model) and 86.4% on tau2-bench retail agentic tool use, with benchmarks approaching the 26B MoE on the 12B variant.
Google also released macOS versions of AI Edge Gallery and a new AI Edge Eloquent on-device voice dictation app to run Gemma 4 12B locally.

stories.headline: Iran drone hits Kuwait airport killing one; FM Araghchi says peace talks made 'no tangible progress'

key_facts.fact: An Iranian drone strike on Kuwait International Airport killed one person and wounded 63, damaging a passenger terminal that had reopened only on Monday after months of war-related closure

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said negotiations to end the war have made 'no tangible progress' and warned an Israeli attack on Beirut would trigger a 'full-scale resumption' of the conflict

US CENTCOM said an additional wave of Iranian drones tried to target US forces in Kuwait but failed, and dismissed as false IRGC claims that Iranian missiles hit the US Fifth Fleet headquarters in Bahrain
Hezbollah said it launched 13 attacks against Israeli forces in southern Lebanon on Wednesday targeting troop gatherings, military vehicles and army command posts

Oil prices rose more than 2% on the renewed Gulf hostilities; the Strait of Hormuz, which previously handled about a fifth of global oil and LNG shipments, remains largely closed more than three months after the US-Israeli strikes on Iran

Israeli drone strikes killed at least six people in southern Lebanon on Wednesday and targeted a car just south of Beirut, the closest strike to the Lebanese capital since a US-mediated partial ceasefire announced Monday

stories.headline: Lila Sciences in talks for $2B Series B at $8.5B valuation, anchored by CalPERS and Nvidia

key_facts.fact: AI-for-science startup Lila Sciences is in talks to raise about $2 billion at a pre-money valuation of about $8.5 billion, per Bloomberg.
The Series B financing is anchored by the California Public Employees' Retirement System (CalPERS) and Nvidia's venture arm NVentures.
Lila closed a $350 million Series A in October 2025 at a >$1.3B valuation, after a $200M seed; its valuation roughly 6x's in eight months on AI-discovery promises.

Founded in 2023 by Flagship Pioneering (the incubator behind Moderna), Lila is building 'AI Science Factories' — automated robotic labs running experiments driven by its models — and claims early proof of concept generating novel antibodies and carbon-capture materials.

stories.headline: Nvidia acquires Kumo AI for at least $400M to expand enterprise predictive models

key_facts.fact: Nvidia acquired Kumo AI for at least $400 million, according to The Information; Kumo's three co-founders have already transitioned to Nvidia.
Kumo builds foundation models that make predictions on structured enterprise data (customer, payment) using graph machine learning techniques developed by its Stanford-pedigreed founders.
Kumo had previously raised $37 million from Sequoia Capital and others in 2022 at a $250 million valuation, per PitchBook, and counts Reddit, DoorDash, Databricks, and Snowflake as customers.
Kumo released its latest model, KumoRFM-2, in April 2026; the deal adds to Nvidia's recent string of acquisitions, including a reported $20B Groq acqui-hire and Illumex for around $75M.

stories.headline: OpenAI publishes blueprint pushing mandatory CAISI evaluations and state-law preemption for frontier AI

key_facts.fact: OpenAI published 'A blueprint for democratic governance of frontier AI' on June 3, 2026, proposing that the Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) conduct mandatory pre-deployment evaluations of the most capable frontier models.

The blueprint diverges from President Trump's June 2 executive order, which lodged a classified covered-frontier-model benchmark with the NSA and CISA and bars any mandatory licensing or preclearance requirement.
OpenAI says CAISI should conduct evaluations and recommend mitigations but not approve or block deployments, and developers should be free to deploy if CAISI misses a statutory timeline.

The blueprint calls for federal preemption of state safety laws (referencing California SB 53, New York's RAISE Act, and Illinois SB 315) and treats recursive self-improvement as an urgent priority for CAISI monitoring.

stories.headline: Honeywell-backed Quantinuum raises $1.68B in upsized IPO at $15.6B valuation

key_facts.fact: Quantinuum raised $1.68 billion in an upsized US IPO, selling 28 million shares at $60 each, above its marketed range of $53 to $55
The IPO valued the quantum computing company at $15.6 billion

stories.headline: Corporate-spend platform Ramp raises $750M at $44B valuation led by Iconiq, GIC, OTPP

key_facts.fact: Ramp raised $750 million in a new funding round at a $44 billion valuation
The round was led by Iconiq, Singapore's GIC, and the Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan (OTPP), taking Ramp's total funding to about $3 billion

stories.headline: Grimes County approves 35-year tax abatement for SpaceX's $55B Terafab chip plant

key_facts.fact: Grimes County commissioners voted 4-1 on June 3 to approve a reinvestment zone and 100% property tax abatement for SpaceX's Terafab semiconductor facility.
The tax abatement lasts 35 years and is initially valued at $55 billion, with potential to scale to $119 billion across multiple phases.
Under the PILOT (payments in lieu of taxes) structure, SpaceX will pay $10M upfront and $20M annually, totaling about $710M over 35 years.

The project, planned for the former Gibbons Creek Power Plant site, would aim to provide 'a terawatt of computing power each year,' more than 10 times the current capacity of all AI infrastructure, per SpaceX.
More than 100 residents attended a heated hearing warning the project could strain water and power, harm wildlife, and alter the county's rural character.

stories.headline: TSMC CEO warns chip supply won't meet AI-fueled demand for years

key_facts.fact: TSMC CEO C.C. Wei told shareholders on June 4 that the company's global chip supply will fall short of AI-fueled demand for years to come, even as more US capacity comes online.
Wei said TSMC will refrain from the kind of abrupt price hikes that shook up the memory sector, prioritizing stable business over margin expansion.
Wei reiterated TSMC's forecast for sales growth of more than 30% in 2026, with capex trending toward the upper end of a $56 billion range.
Wei said hyperscalers are set to spend $725 billion on AI this year, far outstripping TSMC's expansion plans.
Asked whether TSMC could raise prices, Wei said he would 'like to do that' but would never push toward 80% gross margins like some memory peers.

stories.headline: Ukrainian drones hit St. Petersburg oil terminal, Kronstadt naval base, Tambov plant in deep strike

key_facts.fact: Ukrainian long-range drones struck the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal on June 3, flying more than 1,000 km to hit one of Russia's largest oil transshipment hubs in the Baltic region
The strikes hit on the opening day of the St. Petersburg International Economic Forum (SPIEF), Russia's flagship event for attracting foreign capital, with Putin scheduled to address it Friday
Ukraine's Unmanned Systems Forces set fire to the Russian guided-missile corvette Boikiy in dry dock at the Kronstadt naval base, the main stronghold of Russia's Baltic Fleet
Drones also hit the Progress plant in Michurinsk, Tambov region, 600 km from the front line, which produces aviation and missile control equipment for Russia's military
Russia fired 198 long-range drones at Ukraine overnight; Ukraine's air force neutralized 189
Local authorities reported 59 drones shot down overnight; three districts of St. Petersburg were hit; the city's airport briefly suspended flights and mobile internet was cut
